trigger.query: does this authoring guide skill actually help the agent, or is it decorative?
diagnose where meta:new-skill falls short and propose fixes
audit this review-lens skill — measure its real effect on the output
the guide skill doesn't seem to change what the agent produces, prove it either way
improve this guide skill without dropping what already worked
run a with-and-without comparison on this house-convention skill
scaffold a brand-new skill for writing changelogs
refresh the metadata.yaml for this skill after I edited its body
does this skill's description trigger on the right queries?
write me a react component for a date picker

acceptance: every dispatched axis returns a number (Quality Impact d*m, Instruction Compliance SkillScore, and — when embeddings are available — Trigger Precision and Solution-Path Coverage), or an explicit not-run reason, never a silent skip
findings are split into guide-fault (skill-fault f>0, fixable in the guide) and agent-fault (not a guide defect)
the baseline agent was isolated from the repo — no reading of sibling skills
if a fix was applied, a before/after judge ran and confirmed every must-survive item (boundary clauses, correctness checks, at least one example) is still present
